source.title: Londonderry Standard, 2 June 1924, p. 7 ("Derry Rural District Council: Eglinton election result")
source.publisher: Londonderry Standard (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the Londonderry Sentinel's nomination list of 26 April 1924; the Eglinton votes read on the Londonderry Standard's report of 2 June 1924

note: Nomination-day report for the district electoral divisions of Londonderry (Derry No. 1) rural district, one member each. Ten candidates were returned unopposed. At Lough Enagh three candidates were nominated for two seats but both Hanna candidates withdrew, leaving William G. Lynch returned. Eglinton alone went to the poll on 30 May 1924. Craig, the former member, 310; Gilfillan, 128; majority 182. Two spoiled papers.
